# curl --ai-help

This `curl` is curl 8.22.0 reimplemented in C#, a drop-in replacement: the same options, exit codes and output bytes. Run it as `curl [options...] <url>`. This page is the Markdown option reference for AI agents; `curl --help` is the one for people.

## Categories

Every option is filed under one or more of these categories. Expand one with the command after it.

- `auth`: Authentication methods. Run `curl --ai-help auth`
- `connection`: Manage connections. Run `curl --ai-help connection`
- `curl`: The command line tool itself. Run `curl --ai-help curl`
- `deprecated`: Legacy. Run `curl --ai-help deprecated`
- `dns`: Names and resolving. Run `curl --ai-help dns`
- `file`: FILE protocol. Run `curl --ai-help file`
- `ftp`: FTP protocol. Run `curl --ai-help ftp`
- `global`: Global options. Run `curl --ai-help global`
- `http`: HTTP and HTTPS protocol. Run `curl --ai-help http`
- `imap`: IMAP protocol. Run `curl --ai-help imap`
- `ldap`: LDAP protocol. Run `curl --ai-help ldap`
- `mqtt`: MQTT protocol. Run `curl --ai-help mqtt`
- `output`: File system output. Run `curl --ai-help output`
- `pop3`: POP3 protocol. Run `curl --ai-help pop3`
- `post`: HTTP POST specific. Run `curl --ai-help post`
- `proxy`: Options for proxies. Run `curl --ai-help proxy`
- `scp`: SCP protocol. Run `curl --ai-help scp`
- `sftp`: SFTP protocol. Run `curl --ai-help sftp`
- `smtp`: SMTP protocol. Run `curl --ai-help smtp`
- `ssh`: SSH protocol. Run `curl --ai-help ssh`
- `telnet`: TELNET protocol. Run `curl --ai-help telnet`
- `tftp`: TFTP protocol. Run `curl --ai-help tftp`
- `timeout`: Timeouts and delays. Run `curl --ai-help timeout`
- `tls`: TLS/SSL related. Run `curl --ai-help tls`
- `upload`: Upload, sending data. Run `curl --ai-help upload`
- `verbose`: Tracing, logging etc. Run `curl --ai-help verbose`
- `extensions`: Curl's own extensions beyond upstream curl, which `curl --extensions-help` lists. Run `curl --ai-help extensions`

## Most-used options

- `--request <method>` (`-X`): Specify request method to use
- `--header <header/@file>` (`-H`): Pass custom header(s) to server
- `--data <data>` (`-d`): Post data
- `--json <data>`: HTTP POST JSON
- `--form <name=content>` (`-F`): Specify multipart MIME data
- `--user <user:password>` (`-u`): Server user and password
- `--output <file>` (`-o`): Write to file instead of stdout
- `--remote-name` (`-O`): Write output to file named as remote file
- `--upload-file <file>` (`-T`): Transfer local FILE to destination
- `--location` (`-L`): Follow redirects
- `--silent` (`-s`): Silent mode
- `--show-error` (`-S`): Show error even when -s is used
- `--fail` (`-f`): Fail fast with no output on HTTP errors
- `--show-headers` (`-i`): Show response headers in output
- `--verbose` (`-v`): Make the operation more talkative
- `--write-out <format>` (`-w`): Output FORMAT after completion
- `--max-time <seconds>` (`-m`): Maximum time allowed for transfer
- `--insecure` (`-k`): Allow insecure server connections
- `--cookie <data|filename>` (`-b`): Send cookies from string/load from file
- `--user-agent <name>` (`-A`): Send User-Agent /<name> to server

## More

Run `curl --ai-help <category>` for one category's options in full, or `curl --ai-help all` for every option, the exit codes and the `--write-out` variables.
